_comment: This is the mutable brain. It lives in the GitHub repo root, NOT on the domain.
Edit it, push, and the change is live within a few minutes - no host access, no
APK rebuild. index.html on the domain never has to change again.
assetVersion is the only cache control that matters. jsDelivr caches a branch URL
for up to 12 hours, so after pushing a new player.js or channels.json you MUST bump
assetVersion or clients will keep the old copy for half a day.
enabled=false keeps ads completely off, so you can ship the site and apply to
networks before any ad code runs. Flip to true only once a zone is approved.
vastTag is the single line you paste from the HilltopAds dashboard.
midRollMinutes: broadcast-normal is 8-15. Below 5 is how you get uninstalled.
idleMinutes: stop requesting ads after this long with no remote input. People
leave TV apps running in empty rooms, and billing an empty room is the exact
pattern that gets publisher accounts terminated. Do not raise this casually.

sources._comment: Shown on /about.html. Keeping this honest and public is part of why a network approves the site.
